overall_goal: Prepare chicken stock and add it along with extra water to the pan

goals.description: Prepare a mug with hot water
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a mug from the cupboard, places it on the counter, and pours hot water into it from the kettle.

goals.description: Retrieve a chicken stock cube and a spoon
goals.rationale: The person gets a chicken stock cube from the fridge and a small spoon from the drawer to prepare the stock.

goals.description: Dissolve the chicken stock cube in the hot water
goals.rationale: The person unwraps the stock cube, drops it into the mug of hot water, and uses the spoon to break it apart and stir until it is fully dissolved.

goals.description: Add the dissolved chicken stock and extra water to the pan
goals.rationale: The person pours the prepared chicken stock from the mug into the pan, then uses the kettle to add additional hot water as needed.
